source_cuts.name: Sir Imbert
source_cuts.content_text: It is my oath! I will fight until the magic is gone from this realm!

source_cuts.name: Ywaleth Yoster
source_cuts.content_text: The footprints lead in this direction. I'm on the trail!

source_cuts.name: Linlos Dustman
source_cuts.content_text: I spoke with an ant the other day, but I didn't understand what he said. I guess I'm not so good at talking to animals.

source_cuts.name: Koba
source_cuts.content_text: On behalf of all the outcasts and who have been called monsters... I will show them the REAL MONSTER!

source_cuts.name: Lavena Vol
source_cuts.content_text: And they call these spells forbidden magic. Ha! What's the worst that could happen anyway?
